notes: Strong, fully mapped spec: every criterion has a named test or command, error texts are exact, and the operator-settled rows are carried. It leaves some corners open: top-level scalars, --code, python-api.rst, and the no-version-bump rule. The test names use a placeholder-free pytest proof format, so the proof column is machine-runnable.
